assumptions.floating_point: IEEE-754 binary64 (roundTiesToEven), hardware fsqrt/fadd/fsub/fmul/fdiv, deterministic system libm (ln, cos, exp, powf, ln_1p) on host darwin-arm64; no -ffast-math or FMA contraction across statement boundaries
assumptions.runtime_and_resources: Deterministic single-seeded StdRng (ChaCha12) and NumpyPcg64 / SplitMix64 streams; bounded heap allocation without OOM; POSIX mmap/pwrite for BpAnnDiskBackend; 16 MiB stack owner thread for libbaux_numerical.so C-ABI checker

device_scope.statement: Equivalence and compiled-artifact correspondence are established ONLY for the CPU reference optimizer and BPANN backends (ennbo 0.4.1, ennbo-bpann 0.4.1, baux, baux-optimizer-extraction, libbaux__research_BauxResearch.a, libbaux_numerical.so). Accelerator device kernels (Metal/MPS and CUDA/PTX/SASS) are explicitly excluded and NOT established by this CPU proof.

upstream.source: git archive of pinned revision; working tree edits excluded; tracked single-call extraction harness injected

documented_local_corrections: fit.rs (compute_loglik & loo_neighbors): local evaluates -0.5*ln(2*pi) - ln(se) - 0.5*((y - mu)/se)^2 without squaring se (avoiding binary64 se*se underflow below 1e-154) and excludes held-out LOO rows by exact row ID (id != held) rather than distance threshold 1e-15

knn (ExactBackend vs FaissBackend and smnsrch): local in-memory ExactBackend computes exact binary64 squared-L2 distances (matching baux::semantics::neighbor and upstream small_n_search f64 bit-for-bit), while local BpAnnDisk smnsrch uses binary32 resident flat cache (matching upstream FaissBackend f32 bit-for-bit)
acquisition.rs (UCBAcquisition & ParetoAcquisition::nondomin_2d): local uses a deterministic streaming min-heap without advancing RNG in UCB and an O(n log n) 2D sweep in Pareto non-dominated sorting
